• 3.50 HPRD (direct care service hours): Each facility shall employ sufficient nursing staff to provide a minimum of 3.50 direct care service hours per patient day (except as set forth in HSC 1276.9). Inspections & deficiencies

Severe-only narrows rows to the high-harm band. Full shading rules are in “How citations work”.
How inspection citations work
  • Survey date → PDF: Valid dates link to the Medicare Care Compare inspection PDF. Otherwise the cell shows the reason the PDF URL is unavailable.
  • Scope/Severity (A–L): CMS encodes scope and resident harm in one letter per deficiency. Earlier letters are lower risk; later letters are higher. The table sorts using a small PBJ320 letter→rank map (config/citation_severity_rank.json) so ordering matches our “G+” / severe filters — that rank is not a separate CMS-published field.
  • Row color: Amber highlights deficiencies from letter G upward (moderate-to-serious harm band). Red highlights the stricter “severe” band used by the Severe only (H and above) checkbox filter.
  • Survey quarters: Deficiency rows roll up by the inspection survey date calendar quarter. That label may not match this facility’s PBJ work-date quarter or CMS Provider Information processing quarter for the same period.

Non-nurse PBJ table
  • CMS publishes one row per calendar work day per role bucket; this dashboard sums duplicate work dates before quarter totals.
  • HPRD in each cell = sum of that group’s hours for the quarter ÷ sum of MDScensus in the quarter (resident-day–weighted, same spirit as nurse PBJ summaries).
  • days = distinct work dates present in the file for that quarter after collapse. Compare to calendar_days_in_quarter (full Medicare quarter) when judging coverage gaps.
  • Leadership columns (administrator, medical director) also show 0-hour day counts and missing work rows vs. the calendar quarter when relevant.
  • Column order matches the server roll-up list in config/nonnurse_staff_groups.json (not alphabetical). Quarter rows are newest first.
  • Very small HPRD values may show as minutes per resident day with HPRD as a secondary line. A faint green or rose cell tint marks a change vs. the next-older quarter in the table (not a staffing target).
  • Column groups roll up related PBJ hour columns (shown in each column header tooltip).
Staffing compliance tools
  • Census exclusions: Days with zero census are excluded from total days and from met / not met counts (rare).
  • Days below standard table: Open day scrolls to the daily table and loads metrics in the background. Roster opens Employee Detail for that date when enabled. Day PDF is next to the daily table CSV export.
  • Additional insights charts: When shown, they summarize non-compliant days only by weekday and by calendar quarter.
  • California statutory excerpts (when shown in this section) are reference text; confirm current regulatory text for legal use.
Benchmarks & Harrington context

Quarterly PBJ; Provider Info charts (quarter-matched); CMS Case-Mix; Harrington expected staffing.

Harrington table: CMI quarters from 2024 Q1, newest quarter first; rows only when nursing CMI exists in Provider Information.

Trend charts: quarter labels follow Provider Info rows aligned to PBJ quarters (staffing-based match; non-staffing fields may refresh on a different cadence).

Red flag history

Red flag indicators are a PBJ320 metric based on CMS data (SFF status, 1-star ratings, abuse, ownership changes, admin turnover, etc.). Quarters are matched between PBJ and Provider Information. Matched-quarter methodology.

When NH Health Citations are loaded for this CCN, deficiency scope/severity letters use the same PBJ320 rank map as the Inspections table (including the Severe only (H and above) filter and G+ row shading). Red flags and citations are separate extracts but share that letter ordering for consistency.

Outlier screening

|Z| ≥ 2 highlights days where daily PBJ is unusual vs. the in-range mean for the metric and direction you select. Use Current range for the active filter or All history for the full loaded timeline.

Regional peer rollups

State = CMS PBJ staffing rolled up to all reporting nursing homes in your state for the quarter selected in the geography control. National = the same published rollup for all U.S. facilities in that quarter. CMS region = the multi-state peer group (e.g. Boston Region 1); values come from the published regional series.

The interactive table lines up this facility’s PBJ nurse metrics to those three peer series using the bundled quarterly files shipped with this dashboard (not a custom ad hoc sample).

{{ sec_methods }}. Methodology{{ sec_methods }}. Methodology and Sources

Definitions and calculations
Staff Categories
  • Total Staff: All nursing staff including RNs, LPNs, CNAs, RN/LPN administrators, and DON
  • Direct Staff: Staff providing direct patient care (excludes administrators and DON)
  • Total RN (Registered Nurse): Includes RNs + RN administrators + RN DON (Director of Nursing)
  • Direct RN: Excludes RN Admin, RN DON.
  • LPN (Licensed Practical Nurse): Includes direct care LPNs + LPN administrators
  • Nurse Aides: Includes CNAs + NA trainees + Medication Aides
  • Contract Staff: Temporary/agency staff (marked with "_ctr" suffix)
Calculations
  • HPRD (Hours Per Resident Day): Total hours ÷ census for the same day or period.
  • Contract Staff %: (Contract hours ÷ Total hours) × 100
  • Summary period HPRD (banner / API summary): Sum of staff hours ÷ sum of census across filtered days (resident-day weighting), not the simple mean of each day’s HPRD column.
  • Other summary fields: Mean census (etc.) are ordinary arithmetic means across days unless stated elsewhere in this section.
  • Rounding: Half-up (ROUND_HALF_UP) for displayed values; CSV tooltips may restate rounded components for readability.
  • EIN roster — daily hour realism (CMS PBJ):
  • % Case-Mix HPRD: (Reported HPRD ÷ CMS case-mix expected HPRD) × 100 — i.e. reported as a percent of the acuity-based staffing targets in Provider Information. Values below 100% indicate reported staffing below that CMS-reported benchmark for the quarter; above 100% indicate surplus. Methodology: Five-Star / Care Compare Technical Users’ Guide (PDF); broader QM & case-mix docs: Nursing Home Quality Initiatives. Dataset: Nursing Home Provider Information (4pq5-n9py).
  • Non-Direct Staff: RN Admin/DON & LPN Admin hours per resident day
  • State peer rank (summary pod): When shown, “higher than X% of {state} facilities” uses bundled facility_lite_metrics.csv for the same CMS quarter as the Provider-Info–matched PBJ quarter — a cross-sectional rollup, not your custom date filter.
Harrington Expected Staffing

The Harrington Expected formulas adjust expected staffing based on CMS Case-Mix Index (CMI) to account for resident acuity. The on-dashboard quarterly table includes CMI quarters from 2024 Q1 onward, newest first. Expected HPRD and %-of-expected use full-precision CMI and contract constants; table cells round for display only.

  • Total Expected HPRD: 3.48 + ((CMI - 0.62) / (3.84 - 0.62))0.715 × (7.68 - 3.48)
  • RN Expected HPRD: 0.55 + ((CMI - 0.62) / (3.84 - 0.62))0.974 × (2.39 - 0.55)
  • Nurse Aide Expected HPRD: 2.45 + ((CMI - 0.62) / (3.84 - 0.62))0.236 × (3.6 - 2.45)
  • % of expected: 100 × (reported HPRD ÷ Harrington expected HPRD), rounded; diff columns in CSV = reported − expected.

Primary citation: Nursing Home Guide to Adjusting Nurse Staffing for Resident Case-Mix (Harrington et al., Journal of the American Geriatrics Society).

Note: Direct Care metrics are calculated from PBJ and exclude Admin/DON.

CMS case-mix / Five-Star context: Care Compare / Five-Star Technical Users’ Guide (PDF) · Nursing Home Quality Initiatives (quality measures & case-mix documentation).

NH health citations & deficiencies
  • Source: CMS NH Health Citations (provider-data catalog).
  • Scope/Severity (A–L): CMS uses one letter per deficiency (scope + resident harm). The dashboard colors cells by letter band; column sort uses the PBJ320 rank map in config/citation_severity_rank.json (portfolio “red flag” counts treat about G and above as serious; Severe-only is a stricter band, about H and above by default).
  • Survey timing: Deficiency timelines and “survey quarter” labels use the inspection survey date — not PBJ work-date quarters or Provider Information processing quarters.
  • Red Flag History: When present, G-or-higher deficiency citations are merged into the facility red-flag narrative (counts and date span from flagged rows).
Non-nurse PBJ staffing
  • Source: CMS PBJ — Daily Non-Nurse Staffing.
  • HPRD & hours: Non-nurse hours follow CMS role columns; HPRD-style values use the same sum-hours ÷ census spirit as nurse PBJ where displayed in this dashboard.
  • Deduping: Rows are deduplicated on WorkDate (and aligned keys) so daily totals and calendar coverage are not double-counted when CMS publishes overlapping extracts.
  • Signals: Leadership and coverage callouts flag sparse categories or all-zero non-nurse days relative to loaded quarters; see the non-nurse section headers for the exact thresholds.
Statistical Analysis
  • Z-Score: (Value - Mean) ÷ Standard Deviation
  • Outlier Detection: |Z-Score| ≥ 2.0 (High), |Z-Score| ≥ 3.0 (Extreme)
  • Percentile: Approximate ranking compared to historical data
  • Holidays: Federal holidays as defined by U.S. government
Numerical behavior & audit-oriented choices

Judgment calls and implementation details for litigation-grade use. Where the UI disagrees with a naïve mean, the behavior below is intentional.

  • Server pipeline (daily row file): Derived columns (e.g. total staff hours, total HPRD) may apply per-row rounding before storage. Filter-level summary HPRD still uses sum(hours) ÷ sum(census) on those columns, so it tracks CMS intent; tiny drift vs raw unpublished CMS sums is possible.
  • Summary contract % (/api/summary): Uses the mean of each day’s total contract % in the filter, not necessarily sum(contract hours) ÷ sum(direct hours) recomputed from raw numerators (those can differ slightly under edge cases).
  • Snapshot modal — PBJ Trends chart: Each daily point is that row’s total HPRD. Month / quarter / year buckets use sum(Total Staff Hours) ÷ sum(MDScensus) for days with census > 0 so the curve matches aggregate HPRD math; days with missing or non-positive census are left out of the bucket (conservative vs counting hours with no resident denominator).
  • Acuity / CMS % Case-Mix (overview pod & snapshot label): Anchors to the latest quarter in the filter that has bundled Provider case-mix, walking backward from the newest PBJ quarter when CMS has not yet published CMI for that quarter (avoids a blank acuity readout when daily PBJ runs ahead of Provider Information).
  • Published geography — calendar year: Peer HPRD and related fields are the simple mean of bundled quarterly published values for that year. That is not a CMS resident-day–weighted national/state recomputation unless the underlying files already represent that.
  • Published geography — “This facility”: Same sum-hours ÷ sum-census rule as summary, but only days with census > 0 in the chosen quarter or calendar year (see geography card).
  • Geography period dropdown: Saved scope in browser storage is checked against the current filter’s min/max work dates; invalid years or quarters reset to Latest in filter and storage is corrected. An empty data array from /api/data is not replaced with a prior cached row set for geography or state-min counts (avoids stale years).
  • State minimum caption (overview bullet): If no MACPAC-style state minimum is loaded for the facility, the bullet says so explicitly — a substitute federal number is not labeled as the state threshold.
  • Audit scope line (filters / watermark): If quarter or date-range APIs fail, the displayed span uses this page’s CMS work-date bounds when available; it does not fall back to a fixed invented year range.
  • Client display helpers: Functions such as roundHalfUpDisplay return formatted strings for UI and labels; core ratios in script use numeric API fields, not parsed display strings.

Employee Detail (EIN) ↔ Daily PBJ
Flow: PBJ bucket (underlined value) → Day roster → Employee quarter trend.

CMS Employee Detail extracts bundled here usually begin around Q2 2020. Earlier PBJ quarters may have no EIN rows (or show “no data”) unless you load an older CMS file.

PBJ bucket → EIN code(s)
  • Hrs_RN → 7
  • Total RN → 5, 6, 7 · Hrs_RNadmin → 6 · Hrs_RNDON → 5
  • Hrs_LPN → 9 · Total LPN → 8, 9 · Hrs_LPNadmin → 8
  • Hrs_CNA (CNA line only) → 10
  • Total nurse aide (Hrs_CNA + Hrs_NAtrn + Hrs_MedAide) → 10, 11, 12
Roster job codes (EMPLEE_JOB_CD_ID)
1 Administrator · 5 RN DON · 6 RN Admin · 7 RN · 8 LPN Admin · 9 LPN/LVN · 10 CNA · 11 aide in training · 12 med aide

Role position numbers (#1, #2, …): For each job code, employees are numbered in order of first work day in the loaded Employee Detail file for that role (then tie-break by employee ID). #1 = earliest first appearance for that code; several people each keep their own #. In All quarters roster view, rows are grouped person×role (employee-first), and Active means that person×role appears in the most recent quarter. Labels are for readability only. Not inspection citations: Deficiency tags, Form 2567 statement numbers, and similar citation labels come from a different CMS system and are unrelated to these roster numbers or job codes.

Cross-check in roster modal: PBJ daily column sum vs Employee Detail code-sum for that date. Warning threshold is ~±2.5 h or ~3%. Direct RN compares Hrs_RN vs code 7; total RN compares Hrs_RN + Hrs_RNadmin + Hrs_RNDON vs codes 5+6+7.

Harrington expected staffing — methodology

This dashboard uses the published Harrington case-mix staffing guide to turn each quarter’s nursing CMI (from CMS Provider Information) into expected HPRD benchmarks, then compares them to reported PBJ HPRD for the same quarter. All displayed numbers use the same half-up (“financial”) rounding as the rest of the facility dashboard.

Expected HPRD from CMI

Let r = (CMI − 0.62) / (3.84 − 0.62). Expected HPRD for each role is intercept + rexponent × (upper − intercept), with constants from Harrington et al.

  • Total nurse HPRD:
    3.48 + r0.715 × (7.68 − 3.48)
  • RN HPRD:
    0.55 + r0.974 × (2.39 − 0.55)
  • Nurse aide HPRD:
    2.45 + r0.236 × (3.6 − 2.45)
% of expected

% of expected = ROUND_HALF_UP(100 × reported_hprd ÷ harrington_expected_hprd, 1)

When either value is missing or the denominator is zero, the cell shows N/A. CSV exports add diff (reported − expected) and work-shown strings for audit.

Reported HPRD (numerator)
  • Direct care: PBJ HPRD excluding RN Admin, RN DON, and LPN Admin (same direct definition as elsewhere on this dashboard).
  • Total: PBJ total HPRD for the role category (total nurse, RN, nurse aide).
Quarters in the table

The quarterly table starts at 2024 Q1 (nursing CMI era for Harrington on this dashboard). Earlier quarters are excluded.

After that cutoff, a row appears only when Provider Information has a resolvable, positive nursing_case_mix_index for that quarter—most calendar quarters will not appear until CMS publishes CMI. Rows use the same case-mix payload as the Case-Mix Acuity table.

Primary citation: Nursing Home Guide to Adjusting Nurse Staffing for Resident Case-Mix (Harrington et al., Journal of the American Geriatrics Society). CMS context: Care Compare / Five-Star Technical Users’ Guide (PDF) · Nursing Home Provider Information (4pq5-n9py).
